events.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive setup yet, but I can keep an eye out and let you know where it’s happening.

events.text: Mina: Sure — it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community hall, and we’re fixing up bikes, lamps, and small furniture. If you can, just bring your toolbox and a few hours to help.
